```sql
SELECT 
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN ans.Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS accepted_rate
FROM main.posts q
LEFT JOIN main.posts ans 
  ON q.AcceptedAnswerId = ans.Id 
  AND ans.PostTypeId = 2
  AND DATE_TRUNC('month', ans.CreaionDate) = '2013-12-01'
WHERE q.PostTypeId = 1
  AND q.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
  AND DATE_TRUNC('month', q.CreaionDate) = '2013-12-01'
```
